Commentary.Commentary: South Africa should and will be disappointed with the fact that they let the visiting side get to this score. They dropped countless chances of batsmen who made them substantially pay. Steyn was the pick of the lot, having picked up 2/43, and others too could have had better figures, if not for the dropped chances. Now, this is a good surface but it won't be easy by any means under the lights. Will the missed catches come back to haunt the Proteas? Let's see how the chase unfolds.

A big score on the board for Pakistan. Almost every single batsman contributed to it. Electing to bat, they lost Zaman early, but the entire innings revolved around Imam and his century. He started by putting a 132-run stand with Babar (fifty), then added 84 with Hafeez (fifty) and 30 with Malik, before he eventually departed after getting to the triple-figure mark. Wasim entered the fray late and with his blitzkrieg, powered Pakistan to 317, which is their 3rd highest score in ODIs in South Africa.
Full and on the pads, Wasim nudges it down to fine leg for a single. Pakistan end on 317/6!
Bangs it in short around off, Sarfraz is surprised by the extra bounce and takes his eyes off it. Attempts fending it off and it goes off the splice of his bat behind the stumps. A single taken.
FOUR! Poor bowling. Bowls short and wide outside off with third man inside the ring. Sarfraz stays back and calmly lofts it over the fielder inside the ring.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Drilled down the ground! Fuller and outside off at 141 kph, Wasim reaches out for it and spanks it down past mid off for a cracking boundary.
Full and on middle, Ahmed inside edges his attempted flick on the pads and it deflects to short fine leg for a run.
Sarfraz Ahmed to bat next.

OUT! Miller takes a ripper! He dropped one earlier in the match, a similar one, but this time he makes no mistake. Steyn delivers it short and outside off, Hasan makes space and swings his bat across the line. It catches the top edge and flies towards long on. Miller rushes forward from the deep, dives and takes a stunner inches above the surface. 10-0-43-2, Steyn leaves his impact in his return game.
Shortish and on leg, Wasim pulls it towards short fine leg for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shortish and on off, slower again, Hasan swings and misses.
A cutter outside off, full in length, Ali is early into it and misses.
Shortish and around leg, Wasim moves back and taps it down to point for a run.
Hasan Ali is the next batsman in.

OUT! Finds the fielder at mid-wicket! Rabada follows the batsman down the leg side with a short ball and Malik tries to pull across the line. Fails to get enough elevation to go over the infield and Beuran Hendricks accepts an easy catch. Good contribution from Shoaib. Important in the context of the game.
Swing and a miss! A slower one outside off, a touch on the shorter side, Malik is early into his shot and hence misses.
Fullish and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Yorker on off, dug out to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Misses! Digs in a short ball on middle, Malik tries to hook but it goes over his head.

FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries for Pakistan! Short ball on middle, angling in, Malik stays back and muscles it behind square leg for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up in a quick time. 300 comes up as well.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl again.
FOUR! Wasim is playing a handy cameo here. This time he has ramped a short ball down to third man and beats the fielder to his right. 15 from the over, 29 in last two.
FOUR! Cracking shot! A full toss on off and Wasim packs a punch and slaps it past his partner to long off for a boundary.
In the air... SAFE! Good length delivery outside off, Malik tries to power it over the leg side but it catches the top edge and falls in front of third man. A single taken.
Short in length and on middle, Wasim stays back and plays an upper cut down to third man. Not enough timing and only a run is possible.
Malik guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Malik plays a beautiful lofted shot. He knows that mid off is up and as soon as Steyn pitches it full on off, Shoaib takes the aerial route over the ring fielder.
Dale Steyn back into the bowling attack.

DROPPED AND FOUR! A chance has gone down for the umpteenth time in this innings. Have really lost count now. Very substandard from the Saffas. A length ball around off, Imad speeds down the track and hammers it down towards wide long off. Reeza Hendricks tries to catch it but it bursts through his hands and goes on to meet the fence. 14 from the over!
FOUR! Perfectly placed! Fuller and on middle, Wasim picks the line and length early, makes space for the swing of his arms and dismisses it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Goes aerial to a length ball but fails to connect properly. It falls in no man's land at long off and they take two.
Full and angling in on middle, it's pushed back to the bowler who collects it and mimes a throw.
Beaten! Knuckle delivery, wide outside off, Imad is deceived as he is early into the shot.
FOUR! Bang! Short and wide outside off, Imad absolutely loves that, he attacks it with all his power and bludgeons it to the cover fence. No chance for the deep fielder.
Shortish and on middle, Wasim goes for the reverse sweep but finds Amla at short third man. Still a run is stolen.
Two wides! Spinning down the leg side, Malik fails to flick and de Kock also fails to collects. It goes behind off his gloves and they cross.
Waits for the ball to spin away and taps it to the left of the short third man fielder for a run.
Forces a full ball through extra cover and returns for the second run.

EDGY FOUR! Tossed up ball on off, Imad clears his front leg for a heave across the line but it takes the outside edge and speeds wide of short third man for a boundary. Doesn't matter how they come as long as they come.
Play and a miss! Loopy again, wide outside off, Wasim swings and misses as the ball turns away.
Loopy ball on off, on the shorter side, Malik moves back and plays it to cover-point for a run.
Advances down the track and slashes his pull shot by fetching a short ball from outside off. It goes down to long on and they cross.
Stays back to a shorter one, Wasim punches it in front of square on the off side for a run.
Slower short ball outside off, no pace on the ball, Malik dabs it down to short third man and jogs across for another single.
Fuller in length on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Width on offer outside off, guided down in front of short third man for one.
Taps a short ball down to backward point and crosses for a brisk single.

OUT! Century and gone! Got distracted, was busy gesturing to his critics and that put his concentration off. Anyway, a fine knock by him and he walks back to a good ovation from the crowd. Loopy full ball around off, turning away, Imam walks forward to loft it over covers but mistimes his shot in the air off the bottom half of his blade. It flies to sweeper cover where van der Dussen takes a good sliding catch. The 30-run stand comes to a close and it's Imad Wasim's job next to partner Shoaib Malik.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on and rotates the strike.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Half-tracker on middle, pulled to deep square leg for one.

5th ODI hundred for Imam-ul-Haq! He has batted sensibly, constructed a few big stands and has put Pakistan on track for a big finish. Shortish delivery outside off, Imam stays back and pushes it through point and takes a single. He is ecstatic, jumps in the air and then gestures someone to shut up by putting his finger on the lips. Hmmm... Now, who needs to keep quiet?
FOUR! Good start to the over! Shamsi drops it short and on off, Imam turns and pulls it with full power to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish and on middle, helped out to mid-wicket.
Goes back and cuts it to point and crosses for a run. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end and an overthrow results.
FOUR! Serves one on the pads, Malik picks it up and deflects it neatly to fine leg for a boundary.
Fullish and outside off, pushed to covers where the fielder made a diving stop.
Imam has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Malik hangs back and pulls it to wide long on for a run.
Andile Phehlukwayo returns to the attack.
A googly outside off, once again on the shorter side, Malik slaps it through point for one.
Half tracker outside off, cut through point for a couple.
Remains inside the crease and eases it through covers for one.
Short and around off, Imam forces it wide of long on for two.

DROPPED! Not for the first time in this innings. Someone of Miller's ability should have taken it. Tossed up ball on middle, Malik tries to heave it over mid-wicket but it turns back in to take the inner half of his blade. It flies behind square leg, Miller comes rushing forward from the deep, puts in a dive but fails to hold on. A single taken.
Fetches a short ball from outside off and drags a pull shot down to long on for a single.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, Tabraiz Shamsi is back on to bowl.
Very full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Slower full ball around off, Malik pushes it gently to the off side.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Malik tries flicking but misses.
Angles in a full ball on off, Malik helps it to mid on.
A touch short and outside off, Imam cracks it off his back foot to backward point where Miller jumps and makes a fine partial stop. A single taken. With this, Imam gets to 1000 ODI runs.
A length ball on middle and leg, Malik helps it through square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Imam gets back and turns it in front of square leg for a single.

Malik works this away towards mid on and both batters set off. The throw comes in at the striker's end and a direct hit is scored, but Imam is in by then and the ball deflects off the stumps past the keeper. The batsmen steal an extra run.
Shoaib Malik walks in next.

OUT! What a catch, Andile Phehlukwayo... take a bow, my man! A wicket was needed for South Africa, desperately, and Phehlukwayo pulls an absolute rabbit out of the hat to get the job done. Rabada bowls it full again, on the stumps, Hafeez smashes this aerially down towards mid on. Andile there, moves to his left and dives full stretch, Superman-like, and just plucks it out of the air. Could see this on loop all day. Superb stuff! Partnership of 84 is broken.
FOUR! Brings up his fifty in style, the 36th in ODI cricket for Mohammad Hafeez. He works this fine down the leg side and sends it across the boundary line.
Stays on the back foot and blocks it out.

That was super close. The fielder almost hit the mark. Imam taps it down in front of point and takes off. The ball is collected and swiftly throws it at the bowler's end. Had he hit, the opener was a goner.
Rabada goes full and attacks the stumps, driven to mid on for a quick single.
Doesn't rise as much as Imam expects it to, so he mistimes this back of a length ball to mid-wicket with a pull.
Full and coming in on middle and off, driven with a straight bat to the bowler.
Rotating the strike well here. Hafeez pushes this back past the bowler and both batsmen cross over.
Short ball angling down, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
High full toss outside off, hit to covers where a misfield from Amla allows the batsmen to take a run.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Imam wrists this away just wide of mid on for a single.
Beuran Hendricks replaces Reeza Hendricks in the bowling attack.
Dot ball to finish. Rabada with a full toss on off stump, it's hit straight back to the bowler.
On the pads, nudged to fine leg for another single.
This short ball is pulled into the leg side. Another run results.
Short of a good length outside off, cut square through the off side for an easy run.
Stays on the back foot and keeps it out solidly.
Full delivery angling in on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket. Both batsmen set off and Hafeez has to slide his bat in as the throw comes in at the bowler's end. It's quite wayward though.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single. 13 off the over, a good one for Pakistan.
FOUR! Runs coming fast now for the visitors. Hafeez gets low to this floated ball and sweeps it square on the leg side for a boundary.
SIX! What a hit. The 200 is up for Pakistan. Spinning into the batsman, some flight on it, Hafeez jumps out and slogs it over mid-wicket for a maximum.

Close. Fuller and slower around off, Hafeez takes a step out and plays at it. It goes off the bottom half and behind to de Kock on the bounce. The keeper takes the bails off, but by that time the batsman is back inside the crease.
Leans into this full delivery and eases it to long off. Single to the total.
Full length ball on off, slower in pace, it's reverse swept towards short third man and a single is collected.
On the shorter side of things, Hafeez stays right behind the line and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length and it's defended down on the leg side.
Too straight in line, easy enough for the opener to work it down to fine leg for one.
At 140 clicks, it's a length delivery outside off, the right-hander dabs it away with an open face to point and gets to the other end.
Short ball into the body, pulled through square leg for a single.
Good running. Hafeez taps this well wide of the cover fielder and both batsmen complete a brisk run.
Kagiso Rabada is brought back on.
Drives this fuller ball through mid on and keeps strike with a single.

Safe! Hafeez survives. Imam taps this wide of cover and takes off. Miller there runs to his right, collects the ball and fires it to de Kock. Hafeez has to put a dive in as de Kock takes the bails off. Replays show the batsman is fine.
FOUR! Neat stuff from Imam-ul-Haq. Uses his feet to step out of his crease and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Full delivery coming back in on leg, Imam somehow manages to jam it out and play it towards the cover area.
Lands it on a length, cut to point for one more.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, cut away through to sweeper cover. One run added to the total.
One Hendricks for another. Reeza into the attack now.
Full and well outside off, the Professor reaches out to it, tries to drive but gets it off the bottom half behind to the keeper.
Play and a miss! Back of a length outside off, Hafeez looks to cut it away late but is unable to make any connection.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Shaping back into the batsman, Hafeez works it away towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Deftly done. Hafeez waits for this length ball outside off, opens the face and runs it down across the third man fence for a boundary. Nicely done.
Wide! Angles it down leg, Hafeez looks to flick it away but misses. Wide signalled.
Length delivery in line of the stumps, Imam stays inside the crease and offers a firm punch down to long on for a run.
A little too straight in line, helped down towards fine leg for a single.
Back-of-the-hand slower one outside off, Imam fails to pick it up and gets beaten for pace.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
In the air but it's safe! Full and well outside off, Hafeez reaches out to it and lofts it over the leaping fielder at point for a single.
A touch short in length and outside off, Imam plays it late and guides it down to third man for a run.
Just over the infield. Back of a length delivery angling into the batsman, Imam jumps out of the crease and mistimes his pull over mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total.
Drinks break.
Good length ball on top of off stump, MH plays it out from the crease to covers.
A slower delivery, very full and dipping in outside off, Hafeez mistimes his drive to covers.
Pitches it up and outside off, Imam drives it through cover-point and takes a single.
A length ball angling down the leg side, Hafeez picks it off his pads and sends his flick shot to deep square leg for one.
Excellent footwork. Jumps out of the crease to a full ball outside off and lofts it over extra cover. The fielder in the deep circles around it and they take a couple.
A little short in length and outside off, Hafeez cuts but finds Miller at point.
Helps a length ball off his pads to deep backward square leg for a run. 9 from the over!
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short in length on middle, pulled behind square leg for two.

Dropped? Just short. Short and outside off, angling away, Hafeez tries to cut it off his back foot but it takes a feather touch and goes behind. De Kock goes down low but it falls just in front of him.
Wide! Back of a length delivery sliding down the leg side, Hafeez fails to flick. It probably clipped his thigh pad but the umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! An overpitched ball around off, Hafeez drills his drive straight down the ground for a boundary. The mid off fielder had no chance to cut it off.
Helps it off his pads to the leg side, finds the gap and takes a run.
Beuran Hendricks comes back into the attack.

Dropped! Another off Steyn's bowling. Amla is the culprit there. A short delivery outside off, Hafeez flashes his bat at it and edges it behind to first slip. Amla reacts a bit late and then tries to catch it with his left hand. Loses his balance, fails to pouch and it goes down begging. Should have done better. Steyn vs Hafeez battle nearly saw the Professor going down yet again.
Goes very full and in the line of the stumps, Hafeez brings his bat down in time to keep it out.
Digs in a short ball on off, Imam leans back and ramps it down to third man. Just uses the pace of the bowler there. One more to the total.
Edgy! Offers width outside off and tempts the batsman for a drive. Hafeez commits himself but gets a big outside edge wide of first slip. A single taken.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Hafeez has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Hafeez has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. 14 from the over, 150 up for Pakistan!
FOUR! Excellent batting! Knows where the fielders are and places his shot to perfection. Outside off, Hafeez cuts it to the vacant third man region and gets back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! What confidence. Just faced a couple of balls before this and now takes on the in-field. Comes down the track and lofts this over mid off for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by Imam. One run added to the total.
Short and wide again. Imam tries to do the same thing but gets beaten for bounce.
FOUR! A bit short outside off, Imam waits for it and cuts it fine. Gets it past the short third man and away to the fence. Good start to the over.
Fuller this time on off, pushed to the cover region.
Similar line just slightly on a shorter side. Hafeez tries to work it away but the ball hits him on his thigh pad.
Mohammad Hafeez walks out to the middle next.

OUT! Three reds! Pakistan lose their review and what a time to get a wicket. He was deprived of one on the very first ball of the over, but no one could stop him on this occasion. Serves this on the leg stump, Azam shuffles across and looks to flicks it away but misses it. Steyn roars and the umpire raises his finger. Babar has a chat and takes it up but Hawk Eye doesn't help him. He has to walk back after a well payed 69. Partnership of 132 comes to a close.
Review time. Big moment in the game. Dale Steyn has caught Babar Azam leg before and the umpire has adjudged the batsman out. It's taken upstairs by Babar, but he looks to be in trouble here.
Back of a length outside off, Imam runs it down to third man.
Outside off, the batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.

DROPPED and FOUR! Oh dear! Shamsi has put down Imam at mid off.  Back of a length ball outside off, Imam shimmies down and looks to slap it over mid off. He hits it to Shamsi there who cannot hold on to it. What adds insult to injury is that the ball cannot be stopped before the ropes and Imam gets a boundary for it.
FOUR! Lovely short to end the over. Leg spinner dragged down. Babar rocks back and pulls this through mid-wicket for a boundary. 8 runs from it.
Full on the stumps, Imam drives it towards mid on for a quick run.
Short and wide again, Imam cuts it with fast hands but the third man fielder cuts it off. They sprint and come back for the second.
Looped up ball outside off, driven to covers.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, played to mid on.
Short on that that fourth stump line. Babar cuts it but is not happy as he hits it towards backward point. A little more on any side and that would be a boundary. They cross.
Length on the pads, turned away to square leg.
Length on the stumps, Imam blocks it from his crease.
Bouncer! Imam does well to evade it.

FOUR! 5th ODI fifty for Imam and he continues his amazing form in this format. What a way to get it. Short ball outside off, Imam hops and cuts it over point. The ball beats the man at third man and crosses the ropes. He has a good conversion rate in ODIs too.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Imam tries flicking it but fails. Wide given by the umpire.
Outside off again, Azam plays it towards third man to get to the other end.
Imam opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Keeps low on middle, Azam controls his pull to short mid-wicket.
SIX! HUGE! Nice from Azam. Loopy ball on middle and leg, Babar gets low and swipes it high over square leg. The ball goes into the stands for a biggie.
Quicker one on middle stump, Azam gives room and cuts it away towards third man. They come back for the second. Shamsi though thinks it hits his pad before the bat so appeals. The umpire is unmoved.
Full and on middle, forced to long on for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut to deep point for a couple.
Beaten! Full and outside off, turning away, Imam is forward in defense but gets beaten.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Imam tries flicking but misses.
100-run stand comes up! Short and on middle, pulled down to fine leg for one. This pair is going strongly and has not looked much in discomfort.
Fullish and on off, BA pushes it down to mid off and takes on Amla. They complete the run easily as Hashim fails to score a direct hit.
Another delivery which is straighter in line, Babar works it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Angles in a full ball on off, Azam brings down a straight bat and pushes it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a run.

Too full in length and wide outside off, Imam reaches out for it and squeezes it towards backward point. Miller stretches forward to attempt for the catch unknowingly that it has bumped before. Smiles after that.
Dale Steyn is back into the attack.
Flighted ball, full and on off, Babar presses forward in defense.
Quicker and fuller on leg, clipped in front of square leg for one.
Pushes a full ball with the spin through covers for a brace.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Strides forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Sliding down the leg side, Imam inside edges his attempted flick onto the pads and it goes wide of de Kock and falls in front of short fine leg. A run taken.
Plays an on drive but finds the fielder inside the ring. Dot ball to end the over.
Misfield in the deep by the debutant! Lands it full and outside off, Azam drives it through covers and Beuran in the deep fumbles while picking the ball. An extra run taken.
Offers width outside off, Imam slaps it to deep point for one.

Keeps it full again, outside off, Babar pushes it back to the bowler who only manages to take the pace off. As a result, it slows down before the mid off fielder and they steal a run. Babar ain't happy with himself, he wanted to play it wide of the bowler and that fielder inside the ring.
Wide! Full in length and just outside the tramline, a knuckle ball, Babar decides late to make a leave.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

Angles in a length ball on off, Imam plays it down with soft hands to cover-point and looks for a run. He is sent back quickly as Faf du Plessis has a shy at the striker's end. Misses and Imam dives back in.

FOUR! That went like a bullet to the fence! Shamsi drags his length short around leg, Babar picks it early and quickly goes back to pull it thunderously through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep dives near the fence but to no avail. Fifty up for Azam, his 10th in ODIs. Continues with his good form.
Fullish and on off, pushed off the front leg to covers.
Flighted and outside off, driven back and Shamsi dived across to his left to make the stop.
Floated on off, pushed back off the front foot to the bowler.
Loopy and full around off, spinning back in, Babar gets forward and defends it near his front pad off the inside edge.
Flighted full ball on middle, it's eased down to long on for a run.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack. A slip in place...
Length ball outside off, it's dabbed down to third man for a run.
Straighter delivery, Imam flicks it through mid-wicket and rushes back for the second run. The throw from the deep to the bowler was quite wide, otherwise it would have been a tight second.
FOUR! That's a fine, fine shot! Wonderful footwork by Imam. He shimmies down the track to a length ball and smashes it over the bowler's head. Mid on and mid off are up, a boundary results.
Pitches it up this time, outside off, Babar drives off the front foot but finds mid off for a single.
Digs in a short ball on leg, Imam jumps out of the crease and pulls it in front of square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, it's cracked away through covers for a run.
Shortish and outside off, Imam remains inside the crease and dabs it to point. Tidy over by Kagiso.
Width on offer outside off, Azam glides it down to third man for a run.
Fractionally short on off, Imam goes on his toes and taps it down to covers for a quick single.
On a length around off, angling away, Imam stays back to play it down to point.
Bouncer around leg, Imam ducks underneath it with his bat hanging like a periscope. Not a good technique, that.
Play and a miss! Back of a length delivery angling away from the southpaw, Imam stands back to push inside the line but misses.

Drinks break. After the early loss of Fakhar Zaman, Pakistan have rebuilt well here. They are batting sensibly here. The run rate isn't the best but the good fact is that no wickets have been lost. How Pakistan play the spinners is what is important here.
Imam comes down the wicket and hits it back down the ground towards long on. A single is taken once more. 5 runs in this over without any risks.
Azam drives through mid on for a single. Pakistan batting sensibly here.
Imam has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Defended by the southpaw towards the point fielder.
A length ball outside off, Babar opens the face of bat at the last moment. It runs to the third man fielder for a single.
Wide! Sprays this one wide outside off by the bowler. Azam looks to cut but it is too far to make any connection. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Pretty full on off stump, Babar comes ahead and drives it towards mid on where Shamsi moves to his left and makes a good stop.
Stays back to a length ball and punches it to covers.
A little short and outside off, Imam tries running it down to third man but the gully fielder interferes with a dive to his left.
Straighter in line, clipped off the pads to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Good timing! It's uppish but in the gap! A length ball angling into the batsman, Babar gets forward and across before lifting his flick over mid-wicket for a boundary.
A touch short and outside off, Babar stays back and taps it down to point.
Pitches it up and outside off, Babar drives it off his front foot but finds the mid off fielder.
Run down to third man for a single by Azam. Retains strike with that one.
On the money, above off stump. Defended back towards the bowler off the back foot.
A length ball on the hips, worked away towards the fine leg fielder. The first one is run pretty quickly and they want the second but decide against it wisely.
A fuller one on middle, driven towards long on by the right-hander. A single is picked up.
On the pads, worked away towards fine leg for a single.
Change of ends for Andile Phehlukwayo.
A length ball outside off, guided down to third man for a single by Azam.
Shorter one again from Rabada, pulled away to deep square leg for a single by Azam.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
A short of a length delivery outside off, Babar defends this one on his toes.
Bowls this one on the hips does Rabada, single down to fine leg ensues. A good flick shot.
Another one outside off this time to the right-hander. He guides it to third man for a single.
Shorter length one outside off, guided down to third man by Imam for a single. Good, smart batting this without taking risks.
Shorter one outside off, punched off the back foot for a single to deep point. 50-run stand comes up between these two.
Slightly flighted on middle, Azam pushes this coming half-ahead towards long on. Shamsi dives to his right but cannot reach the ball, hence, can't prevent the single.
Flatter ball on middle, driven down to mid on by the lefty for a single.
Another flighted one outside off, Imam prods ahead and pushes it towards cover. Looks for the single which would have been fatal if gone for.
Flighted outside off and a hint of turn, Imam pushes it towards cover.
Flatter one on the pads, pushed on the front foot towards mid-wicket by Azam. A single has been taken.
Tabraiz Shamsi comes on now.

Almost! Gets a good line and also makes the ball bounce a bit more than normal. Imam was looking to dab it down to third man but he is beaten by the bounce and the ball flies inches away from the willow.
Wide! This one is down the leg side this time. The 50 comes up for visitors courtesy this wide.
Wide! Sprays this one too wide outside off and it is penalised by the umpire.
Play and a miss! A length ball outside off, keeps a tad bit low. Imam tried to cut it away on the front foot but misses the ball completely.
Azam gets inside the line of the ball on middle once more and flicks it away to deep square leg for a single.

A length ball on off, Azam was looking to do something different there. Gets inside the line and tried to pull it away over mid-wicket but the ball came in and cramped him for room. Runs to mid on tamely.
On the hips and worked away by the southpaw for a single down to deep backward square leg.
Fuller length ball outside off, Azam cuts it away to the right of third man. A single has been taken. Good fielding there to keep it down to one.
Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl now.
A straight bat has been presented in defense by Imam to this length ball on top of off stump. 7 runs off this over, a decent one for the visitors.
Bowls this on the pads, worked away for a single to deep square leg by the right-hander.
Hurled outside off on a length, Imam guides it wide of point for a single down to third man.
A good length ball on off and slightly angling in, Imam was half-ahead in defense and the ball takes the inside edge and goes onto the pads.
Azam shows the angled bat this time to this one on a length outside off. Slight confusion between the batsmen before they finally pick up the single.

FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff from Babar Azam. A fuller one on middle and it is has been dealt with a straight bat by the batsman. The ball runs to the fence, no fielder moved there. Lovely on the eye!
Powerplay 2 now. A maximum of 4 fielders can be positioned outside the 30-yard circle now till 40 overs.
Defended calmly towards cover-point to end the over by the lefty. 9 runs off this over, a good one for Pakistan.
FOUR! Not off the middle of the bat but Imam gets four. A length ball on off, the southpaw charges down the wicket and hits it back past mid on to the fence.
Guided down to third man off the back foot by Azam. Single taken by the batsmen.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven towards mid off on the front foot.
FOUR! Short and on the middle and leg line, Babar stands tall and pulls it away behind square leg for a boundary. That one sat up to be hit, not much pace on it.
A short length ball on middle, defended from within the crease by Azam.
Eases a full ball in the gap at covers for a run.

FANTASTIC STOP! Saves four runs for his side. Babar pulls a short ball by Rabada and it flies off the top edge. It goes towards deep backward square leg, Beuran Hendricks comes running to his left from fine leg, puts in a jump as he goes beyond the line but before his feet touch the ground, he has slapped the ball out. Then, he comes back in and throws the ball back in play. Wonderful effort. The third umpire agrees.
Is that a six? It seems that Beuran Hendricks has done an exceptional effort here. The umpires are checking upstairs...
Azam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angles in a length ball on off, Azam drives it straight bat and Rabada does well to stop it in his followthrough by going down low.
Beaten by a beauty! An away swinger, landing on a good length just outside off, Babar stays back to have a push inside the line but misses.
Good length ball on middle and leg, it's nudged behind backward square leg for a run.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl now.
Good timing once more from Azam, but he finds the fielder at mid off this time though.

Good effort this from Andile Phehlukwayo this time to save runs for his team. This one was on the pads and it is flicked away towards mid-wicket. Would have been a boundary if not for the fielding effort.
This is much better from Azam, keeps this along the ground as he flicks this away towards square leg for another couple.

DROPPED! Andile Phehlukwayo the culprit. These ones have to be taken at this level. A short of a length ball on middle, Azam is late on his pull and it goes at a very slow speed and at a good height towards the mid-wicket region. Looks like Andile mistimed his jump and the ball didn't stay in his hand. The ball runs for a couple till he goes and collects it. Unlucky for the debutant, could have had his second there.
Kept out towards the cover region once more.
A length ball on off stump line, Azam defends from the crease.
Bowled on the leg stump line, Imam tries to glance it fine but misses the ball. It goes off the thigh pad towards De Kock who makes a good diving collection to his right. A wayward over from Steyn.
Poor shot selection from Imam. Charges down the ground and goes for a wild slash over the off side but only makes connection with thin air. Not such good batting this.
Slower ball, 125 kph outside off. Imam defends it watchfully towards the cover region.
Wide! Steyn sprays this one down the leg side. It is signalled wide by the umpire.
Short and outside off, Imam would feel he has missed out there. Goes for the cut but fails to make any connection. Steyn gets away with a bad ball.
A length ball outside off and slight swing inward, Imam pushes it towards the cover region.
A short of a length delivery ball on middle, Imam gets on top of the bounce and defends this ball.
Fuller one outside off, driven hard but straight to the cover fielder by Azam.

Quick single! Imam drops this on the leg side off his hips and sets off for a quick run. The fielder at mid-wicket picks it up and throws at the striker's end but misses the stumps. There was a chance of an overthrow to be taken but Babar's followthrough was too much.
Imam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Worked off the pads towards fine leg by Imam and the batsmen start off the first run really hard. Steyn comes under pressure and misfields, allowing for the second run to be taken. Good running.
FOUR! Imam takes a couple of steps down the track, makes room and slashes this short ball outside off over the point region. That is amazing utilisation of the fielding restrictions in the PowerPlay.
Fuller length ball on middle, Imam comes on his front foot and pushes it to mid on.
Back to the good line and again beats the outside edge with the outswing. Good battle this, continuing from where they left off in the Tests. Babar trying to dominate Steyn.
FOUR! Poor one follows the good ball. Short and wide outside off, Babar frees his arms and cuts this away through the covers off his back foot. Beats the infield and goes to the fence.
Oooh! Close! A lovely delivery just outside off and shaping away late. Azam was feeling for the ball but is beaten by the swing. Good ball.
Crunching sound off the bat as Azam punches the length ball outside off, on his back foot towards cover-point. Goes to the fielder though.
Babar pushes ahead and drives this one towards mid on. Does not get good timing on that ball though.
Delivered outside off and shaping away by Steyn, left alone by Azam.
Hendricks hurls this one on the shorter length outside off, Imam responds by defending it towards point.
Fuller one on middle, Imam gets this off the inside half of the bat towards mid on.
A lovely shot but it goes straight to the third man in the deep. Single picked up by Babar, looking positive here.
Azam stays in the crease and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Catch it! was the call from the bowler and fielders. Quinton de Kock dives full length to his left but couldn't reach that one. Babar starts off with a boundary. This one is a short length ball on the hips, Azam comes inside the line and glances it fine on the leg side. Too close for comfort though!
Babar Azam walks in at no. 3, replacing Fakhar.

OUT! High in the air and Zaman is gone! Falls cheaply again. Hendricks gets his maiden ODI scalp. Left-armer gets left-hander. A length ball, around middle, Zaman looks to tuck it to the leg side but only skies it high in the air. Kagiso Rabada gets under it at short mid-wicket and takes it comfortably. Decent start for the debutant.
A fuller length ball on off, driven through the covers by the lefty but straight to the fielder.
Imam shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A short of a length ball outside off, Zaman opens the face of the bat towards third man and picks up a single.
A much straighter and better on drive from Fakhar, Shamsi moves well to his right and makes a lovely tumbling stop to his right.
Pushes this one a little full on off and middle, Zaman drives it towards mid on.

Play and a miss! Fakhar walks down the ground a bit to the first one he faces from Steyn. Tries to cut it away off the length but fails to put bat on ball. Not a smart shot so early on in the innings.
Bowled on middle and leg, Imam works it towards the mid on region. No run though. One run off Beuran Hendricks' first over in ODIs.
Fakhar is off the mark as well as he pushes this one on a full length wide of mid on and gets to the other end.
Keeps this short of a length ball outside off towards the point region.
Fuller length on the off and middle stump, pushed back on the front foot towards the left of mid on by Zaman. The fielder moves to his left and makes a good stop preventing any runs.
Shortens the length a tad bit, defended on the back foot.
Starts off with a slightly fuller one on off stump, Fakhar pushes it back firmly to the bowler.
Beuran Hendricks, the left-arm quick has the other new ball. What can he serve up on his first ball in ODI cricket?
Left alone outside off to end the over. A tidy first one from Dale.
First runs of the day, the ball on a length and a leg stump line is worked away wide of fine leg for an easy couple.
On the middle stump line, defended back towards the bowler from the crease by Imam.
Steyn pushes this a littler further up, Imam was looking to defend it with a straight bat but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg.
Short of a length ball on middle, kept out off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
On the money to start off with from Steyn, just a bit outside off and swinging in. Imam plays it back down towards the bowler.

The players finish singing their respective national anthems. The two opening batsmen for Pakistan are Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq. The latter to take strike against Dale Steyn who has the first new ball in his hands. Let's play...
Changes for Pakistan - Imad Wasim and Mohammad Amir replace Hussain Talat and Faheem Ashraf.
Changes for South Africa - Dale Steyn, Quinton de Kock and debutant Beuran Hendricks replace the trio of Heinrich Klassen, Dane Paterson and Duanne Olivier.
TOSS - Sarfraz Ahmed has called right at the toss and says that PAKISTAN WILL BAT FIRST.

Hello and welcome to Supersport Park for the 3rd ODI between South Africa and Pakistan. The series is evenly poised at 1-1 and tells us exactly why the visitors are always a more competitive limited-overs side. They did fold pretty meekly in the 2nd ODI but one would expect a tougher fight from them in this game. Great news for the hosts though, as two of their stars come back into the team. The Proteas start as favorites in this game but the other team in a darker shade of green are unpredictable and world-beaters on their day. Expect a cracker of a game in amazing conditions at Centurion. Toss to follow...
